title: cystopteris bulbifera
intro: Cystopteris bulbifera, commonly known as Eastern Bladder Fern or Bulblet Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris bulbifera include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help to relieve muscle spasms and promote the expulsion of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
